direct_run_formatting.run_text: INPUT -> MANAGER + SQLITE STATE -> LESSON RETRIEVAL (top three, advisory)
MANAGER -> PROVIDER PLAN -> PYDANTIC / TOOL / BUDGET VALIDATION
VALID PLAN -> SEARCH -> CALCULATE -> SYNTHESIZE -> GROUNDING CRITIC
INVALID PLAN -> ONE REPAIR -> DETERMINISTIC FALLBACK
TOOL OR GROUNDING FAILURE -> OBSERVATION -> BOUNDED REPLAN (max two)

notes: Direct formatting is not always wrong, but it often causes inconsistent output when templates change.
Heading-like paragraphs not using Heading styles can break TOC and accessibility.
